summary: add_file_common_args=True adds standard file options (document with the ansible.builtin.files fragment), and load_file_common_arguments plus set_fs_attributes_if_different apply them.
questions: How do I give my module owner, group and mode options like the file module?
How do I apply file permissions requested by the user in my module?

answer_card.title: Add common file options
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec, add_file_common_args=True)
changed = False
file_args = module.load_file_common_arguments(module.params)
changed = module.set_fs_attributes_if_different(file_args, changed)
module.exit_json(changed=changed)
```
Extend the `ansible.builtin.files` doc fragment so the options are documented.
